graphEvents.label: How do harnesses route free text to a packaged workflow
Cursor dynamic delivery is dormant and a static rule routes instead
All harnesses converge on root doc plus user-invoked surface plus optional hook

label: Every harness converges on three surfaces: a root instruction file, a user-invoked prompt or command surface, and an optional hook; Codex calls AGENTS.md the shared instruction file for every runtime, Pi reads it from the working directory and parents, and Cursor tells the user to type / to see commands.
The only always-applied routing rule in the tree is .cursor/rules/skill-routing.md, a static prose rule with eight skill pointers under alwaysApply: true, naming zero commands.

That rule states the dynamic path is not running: the beforeSubmitPrompt adapter is registered but its per-turn delivery is dormant under the tested CLI build, so the static rule is doing the routing on Cursor.

Devin inherits the same rule rather than carrying its own: its README lists the routing rule inherited from Cursor under Instructions and states there is no rules folder, so two of seven runtimes share one hand-maintained static routing document with no command pointers.

The rule shows the repository pattern for keeping a duplicated routing block honest: its Gate 1 paragraph sits in a generated fence produced by sync-gate1-pointers.cjs from the root AGENTS.md line, with the instruction to edit the root line and not the block, which is the anti-drift mechanism a command pointer block should reuse.

Inference from the seven adapters and the absence of any model-invoked command surface: harnesses expose slash commands as user-invoked entries, not model-callable tools, and the AGENTS.md convention exists so one instruction file serves several harnesses.

Design implication: the binding layer cannot assume a brief arrives, because on Cursor and Devin the reliable surfaces are the static rule and AGENTS.md while the advisor CLI is model-callable everywhere, so the rule must be phrased to work when no brief arrived and the command pointer should be generated into the static rule.
